summary: Frontend-only review of 'rainbow chakra binary code' feature (BinaryBorder / BinaryRule in /app/frontend/src/BinaryCode.tsx). All 8 requested checks pass on the live preview. (1) home-lab-binary contains only 0/1 characters (382 chars at 390w), includes the 432 Hz pattern 0000000110110000, is static when idle (identical 700ms snapshots) at opacity 0.38, changes while home-lab-execute is active (opacity 1.0), and returns to static after STOP. (2) Border digits reach all four edges — measured top-row width/box-width ratio = 1.0 at both 390px and 720px widths and document.scrollWidth equals viewport width (no horizontal overflow). (3) Overlays never block touches — SEND CODES, home-body-map-session-duration-13, and home-body-map-session-play all tappable (pointerEvents:'none' on BinaryBorder's absolute fill confirmed in code). (4) home-body-map-session-binary idle text is only zeros, flows while session tone plays, static after stop; home-body-map-binary (whole-body border) is all-zero/still at rest and flows when any tone plays. (5) Mirrors Wheel: tapping a mirrors-key starts both home-wheel-binary and mirrors-wheel-binary flowing (sample 11110010100000... = 432 Hz = 0x01B0), STOP FREQUENCY returns both to static. (6) Chakra piano: tapping the 432 Hz key starts home-piano-binary flowing (sample 01100000000000110110...), static after toggle-off. (7) BI-NAURAL tab: binaural-title-binary + binaural-freq-binary present and idle-static; freq box flows after INITIATE and returns to static after TERMINATE. (8) BRAIN tab (/moods) loads with 10 pure-01 binary blocks (ChakraBodyMap + MusicalSpiral BinaryBorders), no crash. Codes Archive tab loads without errors. Regression/perf: zero page errors, zero console errors on home, no 'Maximum update depth exceeded' warnings while scrolling with 432 Hz tone playing. No source files modified.

critical_code_review_comments: BinaryCode.tsx:134 — BinaryBorder uses position:'absolute', left/top/right/bottom:0 and pointerEvents:'none' on the fill wrapper, so the overlay correctly never intercepts touches. Verified empirically (SEND CODES, session duration 13, session play all tap through).
BinaryCode.tsx:106 — nh = Math.max(0, Math.floor((size.h - ROW_H*2)/COL_LINE)) prevents negative row counts on very short boxes; OK.
BinaryCode.tsx:50 — useFlow runs a 160ms setInterval only while live; cleared on effect teardown. No runaway re-render warnings observed during 16 scroll ticks with a playing tone.

BinaryCode.tsx:74-83 — single global charW measurement via hidden probe + charSubs set is efficient but relies on the first probe mounting; confirmed digits render on all mounts at 390 and 720 widths.
BinaryCode.tsx:11-13 — toBits pads each Hz value to a full byte, so 432→0000000110110000 (16 bits). Verified in home-lab-binary and mirrors-wheel-binary samples.
